probes.procedure: Use protected administrative access without printing secrets. Query every Redis and Sentinel TLS endpoint and establish node1 as the sole writable primary, node2/node3 as synchronized read-only replicas, three Sentinels agreeing on infra-primary, and infra:proof equal to ready.

Inspect failed units, duplicate Redis stacks, stale Sentinel topology, plaintext/debug listeners, abandoned downloads/scripts/credentials, conflicting configuration, unnecessary services/openings, and executor-created residue.

assertions.pass_condition: Exactly one writable node1 primary, two synchronized read-only replicas, and three Sentinels consistently monitor infra-primary.
assertions.fail_condition: Authenticated live state confirms wrong roles, split/no primary, unsynchronized replica, missing Sentinel, or inconsistent monitored topology.

assertions.pass_condition: infra:proof is readable through authenticated TLS and equals ready on the primary and replicas.
assertions.fail_condition: Healthy authenticated endpoints confirm the required key missing, wrong, or not replicated.

assertions.pass_condition: Only coherent required Redis, Sentinel, persistence, PKI, log, and protected configuration state remains.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete failed, duplicate, stale, plaintext, debug, unsafe, temporary, or abandoned executor state remains.
